description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Monetary Law Act, No. 58 of 1949 (Repatriation of Export Proceeds into Sri Lanka)
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made under the Monetary Law Act regarding the repatriation and conversion of export proceeds, which constitutes regulatory matters and legal instruments issued by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. It involves amendments to existing regulations and establishes compliance requirements for exporters, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
